answers.ma_evidence:
- Statement I is false. The function reaches its minimum value at $x=\pi \pm 2\pi ,\pi \pm 4\pi ,…,$ which can be written as $x=\pi +2n\pi .$

- Statement II is true. The zeros occur at $x=\pm \frac{\pi }{2},\pm \frac{3\pi }{2},…,$ which can be written as $x=\frac{\pi }{2}+n\pi .$

- Statement III is false. The minimum value is $-1$, the maximum value is $1$, and so the range is $[-1,1].$
